The '''''Paramount''''' was a [[Keizar-Volvec/Legends|Keizar-Volvec]] [[Keizar-Volvec bulk cruiser|manufactured]] [[Bulk cruiser/Legends|bulk cruiser]] that was part of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] in [[3643 BBY]]. The ship was described as a "behemoth" with a hollow nose which housed its primary hangar bay. The ''Paramount'' was equipped with a complement of [[B28 Extinction-class bomber|B28 ''Extinction''-class bombers]], [[Mark VI Supremacy-class starfighter|ISF Starfighters]], [[VT-22 light troop transport|VT-22 transports]], shuttles, and carried one [[Mk. VII advanced interceptor]].
